problem:
Problem description
- There is a single-period procurement planning problem for a furniture store that buys identical chairs from a finite set of manufacturers $$\mathcal{M}$$.
- For each manufacturer $$m \in \mathcal{M}$$, the parameter $$c_m$$ denotes the cost of placing one order, and the parameter $$q_m$$ denotes the number of chairs delivered by one order.
- The store must choose integer numbers of orders from the available manufacturers, and each chosen manufacturer may also have an activation status indicating whether it is used at all.
- The total number of chairs ordered must satisfy a lower bound $$D^{\min}$$ and an upper bound $$D^{\max}$$.
- Some manufacturers may have prerequisite relations, represented by a set $$\mathcal{R}$$ of ordered pairs. If a manufacturer is selected, the required manufacturer in the pair must also be selected and must satisfy the associated linked minimum quantity requirement.
- The planning goal is to minimize the total procurement cost of all orders while respecting all quantity bounds and prerequisite relations.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_m$$: the integer number of orders placed with manufacturer $$m \in \mathcal{M}$$
  - $$y_m$$: a binary activation variable for manufacturer $$m \in \mathcal{M}$$, where $$1$$ means the manufacturer is used and $$0$$ means it is not used
  - $$Q$$: the total number of chairs ordered across all manufacturers
  - $$Z$$: the total ordering cost to be minimized

Input Format
{
  "manufacturers": "Array of manufacturer identifiers representing the set $$\\mathcal{M}$$.",
  "order_costs": "Map from each $$m \\in \\mathcal{M}$$ to its per-order cost $$c_m$$.",
  "units_per_order": "Map from each $$m \\in \\mathcal{M}$$ to its fixed order quantity $$q_m$$.",
  "minimum_total_quantity": "Scalar lower bound $$D^{\\min}$$ on the total chairs ordered.",
  "maximum_total_quantity": "Scalar upper bound $$D^{\\max}$$ on the total chairs ordered.",
  "precedence_rules": "Array of rule objects. Each rule specifies a triggering manufacturer $$i$$, a required manufacturer $$j$$, and a linked minimum quantity $$\\ell_{ij}$$ that must be satisfied for $$j$$ whenever $$i$$ is selected."
}

Output Format
{
  "orders": "Map from each $$m \\in \\mathcal{M}$$ to the integer decision $$x_m$$, giving the number of orders placed with manufacturer $$m$$.",
  "selected": "Map from each $$m \\in \\mathcal{M}$$ to the binary decision $$y_m$$, indicating whether manufacturer $$m$$ is used.",
  "total_quantity": "Scalar $$Q$$ giving the total number of chairs ordered.",
  "total_cost": "Scalar $$Z$$ giving the minimized total procurement cost."
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "manufacturers": ["A", "B", "C"],
  "order_costs": {
    "A": 50,
    "B": 45,
    "C": 40
  },
  "units_per_order": {
    "A": 15,
    "B": 10,
    "C": 10
  },
  "minimum_total_quantity": 100,
  "maximum_total_quantity": 500,
  "precedence_rules": [
    {
      "trigger": "A",
      "requires": "B",
      "linked_minimum_quantity": 10
    },
    {
      "trigger": "B",
      "requires": "C",
      "linked_minimum_quantity": 10
    }
  ]
}

parameters.name: manufacturers_count
parameters.description: Number of manufacturers in the ordered set \(\mathcal{M}\)

parameters.name: order_costs
parameters.description: Cost of placing one order with each manufacturer

parameters.name: units_per_order
parameters.description: Number of chairs delivered by one order from each manufacturer

parameters.name: minimum_total_quantity
parameters.description: Lower bound on the total number of chairs ordered

parameters.name: maximum_total_quantity
parameters.description: Upper bound on the total number of chairs ordered

parameters.name: precedence_rules_count
parameters.description: Number of precedence rules in the ordered set \(\mathcal{R}\)

parameters.name: rule_triggers
parameters.description: Triggering manufacturer index for each precedence rule

parameters.name: rule_requires
parameters.description: Required manufacturer index for each precedence rule

parameters.name: linked_minimum_quantities
parameters.description: Linked minimum quantity requirement for each precedence rule

variables.name: order_counts
variables.description: Integer number of orders placed with each manufacturer

variables.name: selected_manufacturers
variables.description: Binary activation variable indicating whether each manufacturer is used

variables.name: total_quantity
variables.description: Total number of chairs ordered across all manufacturers

auxiliary_variables.name: big_m_order_upper_bound
auxiliary_variables.description: Valid finite per-manufacturer upper bound on the number of orders that can be placed with each manufacturer for activation linking

constraints.name: total_quantity_definition
constraints.description: The total quantity equals the sum of chairs delivered by all ordered manufacturer orders.

constraints.name: total_quantity_bounds
constraints.description: The procurement plan must keep the total quantity within the minimum and maximum demand bounds.

constraints.name: manufacturer_activation_link
constraints.description: Order counts are only allowed for manufacturers that are selected, enforced with a valid per-manufacturer finite upper bound linking orders to activation.

constraints.name: precedence_activation_requirement
constraints.description: If a triggering manufacturer is selected, then the required manufacturer must also be selected for every precedence rule.

constraints.name: precedence_linked_minimum_quantity
constraints.description: If a precedence relation is triggered, the required manufacturer must satisfy the linked minimum quantity requirement for every precedence rule.

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: The total cost equals the sum of order costs across all manufacturers.

constraints.name: order_count_integrality
constraints.description: Order counts must be nonnegative integer values.

constraints.name: manufacturer_selection_binary
constraints.description: Manufacturer activation variables must be binary.

constraints.name: nonnegative_quantities
constraints.description: Total quantity and total cost are nonnegative scalar quantities.

objectives.name: total_procurement_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total procurement cost while satisfying quantity bounds and precedence requirements

final_objective.description: Minimize total procurement cost across all manufacturers while satisfying total quantity bounds and precedence requirements.
